Q: Finding the last letter in a string A:

You could (not necessarily should) achieve this using a regular expression as follows:

import re

user_input = input("Write a sentence ")
words = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z]+", user_input)
print(words[-1][-1] if words else "No alpha characters in input string")

This is merely an example of how one could achieve the stated objective. If performance is important (isn't it always?) then don't do this.

Q: Constrain HTTP Header values to a finite list of values A:

The approach you're using with the addition of custom request headers is common. Your documentation should include the valid header types, this makes it easy for devs and customers.

I personally would use a Dictionary or HashSet to load your "enum" from a database. This is just cleaner and simpler to add new instances in the future. You would then want a mechanism for updating the list in memory to pick up any changes.

Your header validation test called in your controller will be very similar to what you have shown for validating an enum. You can enforce the check in every controller method with a single function call, or you can modify the default behavior if you want the check performed on every request received.

You can only handle the headers you expect to receive, for your custom headers you can return 400 if they do not exist or are invalid values, but you cannot check for them to be the only additional headers on the request; for example there are infrastructure mechanisms that could inject headers. The default behavior for headers you do not explicitly handle is that they are ignored.

Q: Trying To Find A batch file A:

How it works

1) Find 7-Zip

Looks for 7z on PATH, then the normal install folders.

where 7z >nul 2>&1 if not errorlevel 1 set "SEVENZ=7z" if not defined SEVENZ if exist "%ProgramFiles%\7-Zip\7z.exe" set "SEVENZ=%ProgramFiles%\7-Zip\7z.exe"

2) Get the root folder

From drag-and-drop / argument, or ask the user.

set "ROOT=%~1" if not defined ROOT set /p "ROOT=Folder: "

3) Confirm the folder exists

if not exist "%ROOT%\" ( echo [ERROR] Folder does not exist: exit /b 1 )

4) Initialize counters

set /a FOUND=0 set /a OK=0 set /a FAIL=0

5) Recursively find every .zip

/r walks the folder tree. For each zip, call a subroutine with:

• full zip path

• output folder = same path/name without .zip (%%~dpnF)

for /r "%ROOT%" %%F in (*.zip) do ( set /a FOUND+=1 call :extract "%%~fF" "%%~dpnF" )

6) Create the output folder if needed

if not exist "%OUTDIR%" mkdir "%OUTDIR%" 2>nul

7) Extract with 7-Zip

• x = extract

• "-o..." = output dir (quotes wrap the whole switch so spaces work)

• -y = overwrite without asking

"%SEVENZ%" x "%ZIP%" "-o%OUTDIR%" -y if errorlevel 1 (set /a FAIL+=1) else (set /a OK+=1)

8) Print a summary

echo Zips found: %FOUND%

echo Extracted OK: %OK%

echo Failed: %FAIL%

=====================================================================

Full script

@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion

:: =============================================================================
::  unzip_all_recursive.bat
::
::  Finds EVERY .zip file in a folder AND all subfolders, then extracts each
::  one into a NEW folder next to the zip, with the SAME name as the zip
::  (without ".zip"). Folder structure is preserved.
::
::  Examples:
::    Z:\Folder\Folder1\File1.zip
::      -> extracts into Z:\Folder\Folder1\File1\
::
::    Z:\Folder\Folder1\Folder2\File1.zip
::      -> extracts into Z:\Folder\Folder1\Folder2\File1\
::
::  HOW TO USE (pick one):
::    1) Double-click this file, then type/paste the folder path when asked
::    2) Drag a folder onto this .bat file
::    3) From Command Prompt:
::         unzip_all_recursive.bat "Z:\Folder"
::
::  Optional 2nd argument: /nopause  (skip "Press any key" prompts)
::
::  REQUIREMENTS:
::    7-Zip must be installed (https://www.7-zip.org/)
:: =============================================================================

echo.
echo ============================================
echo   Recursive ZIP extract (via 7-Zip)
echo ============================================
echo.

:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
:: 1) Find 7z.exe
:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set "SEVENZ="

where 7z >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 set "SEVENZ=7z"

if not defined SEVENZ (
    if exist "%ProgramFiles%\7-Zip\7z.exe" set "SEVENZ=%ProgramFiles%\7-Zip\7z.exe"
)

:: ProgramFiles(x86): "(x86)" breaks parenthesized IF blocks — use a temp var
if not defined SEVENZ set "PF86=%ProgramFiles(x86)%"
if not defined SEVENZ if defined PF86 if exist "!PF86!\7-Zip\7z.exe" set "SEVENZ=!PF86!\7-Zip\7z.exe"

if not defined SEVENZ (
    echo [ERROR] Could not find 7-Zip.
    echo.
    echo Install 7-Zip from https://www.7-zip.org/
    echo Or add 7z.exe to your PATH.
    echo.
    if /i not "%~2"=="/nopause" pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo Using 7-Zip: %SEVENZ%
echo.

:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
:: 2) Which folder to process?
:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set "ROOT=%~1"

if not defined ROOT (
    echo Type or paste the FULL path of the folder that contains your zips.
    echo Example: Z:\Folder
    echo.
    set /p "ROOT=Folder: "
)

:: Strip accidental quotes
set "ROOT=%ROOT:"=%"

if not defined ROOT (
    echo [ERROR] No folder given.
    if /i not "%~2"=="/nopause" pause
    exit /b 1
)

if not exist "%ROOT%\" (
    echo [ERROR] Folder does not exist:
    echo   %ROOT%
    if /i not "%~2"=="/nopause" pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo Will search for .zip files under:
echo   %ROOT%
echo.
echo Each zip becomes a folder with the same name beside it.
echo Existing extract folders will be reused; files may be overwritten (-y).
echo.

if /i not "%~2"=="/nopause" pause

:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
:: 3) Counters
:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set /a FOUND=0
set /a OK=0
set /a FAIL=0

:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
:: 4) Walk every .zip (recursive)
::    Use CALL :extract so paths with spaces don't break a parenthesized FOR body.
::
::    %%~fF   = full path of the zip
::    %%~dpnF = drive+path+name WITHOUT .zip extension
:: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo.
echo Searching...
echo.

for /r "%ROOT%" %%F in (*.zip) do (
    set /a FOUND+=1
    call :extract "%%~fF" "%%~dpnF"
)

goto :summary


:: =============================================================================
:: :extract  "%zip%"  "%outdir%"
:: =============================================================================
:extract
set "ZIP=%~1"
set "OUTDIR=%~2"

echo --------------------------------------------
echo ZIP:  %ZIP%
echo OUT:  %OUTDIR%\
echo.

if not exist "%OUTDIR%" mkdir "%OUTDIR%" 2>nul

:: 7-Zip:
::   x  = extract with paths inside the archive
::   "-oDIR" = output folder; quotes wrap the WHOLE switch (required for spaces)
::   -y = overwrite without asking
"%SEVENZ%" x "%ZIP%" "-o%OUTDIR%" -y
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [FAIL] Could not extract:
    echo        %ZIP%
    set /a FAIL+=1
) else (
    echo [OK] Extracted.
    set /a OK+=1
)
echo.
goto :eof


:: =============================================================================
:summary
:: =============================================================================
echo ============================================
echo Done.
echo   Zips found:     %FOUND%
echo   Extracted OK:   %OK%
echo   Failed:         %FAIL%
echo ============================================
echo.

if %FOUND% equ 0 (
    echo No .zip files were found under that folder.
    echo.
)

if /i not "%~2"=="/nopause" pause
endlocal
exit /b 0

Q: I am using SQL to pull 100+ fields from a database and have a format question for my final output. I want any blanks replaced by N/A A:

Try this in SQL:

IFNULL(NULLIF(column_name, ''), 'N/A')

Explanation:

  1. 3 possible value categories of column_name: NULL, '', and any non-null non-empty strings.
  2. NULLIF() : If column_name contain empty string '', return NULL, otherwise return its original value. So we have only 2 categories left: NULL and any non-null non-empty strings. '' now becomes NULL.
  3. IFNULL() : maps NULL to 'N/A' string. So we have 2 possible results: 'N/A' or any non-null non-empty strings.

In Python, since None (the received value from SQL's NULL) and empty string '' are both treated as logical false value, it's quite easy to detect them as if their are just False, we can leverage Python's logical shortcut operator or:

# Assume val comes from PySpark query result
val = result_row["value"]

# Leverage Python's truthiness: None and '' are both False
normalized = val or "N/A"

Q: Fix for C# Raw Socket, Error 10013 "An attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden by its access permissions" A:

I wouldn't call this behaviour obscure;

Raw sockets offer the capability to manipulate the underlying transport, so they can be used for malicious purposes that pose a security threat. Therefore, only members of the Administrators group can create sockets of type SOCK_RAW on Windows 2000 and later.
